projects.name: From concept to shipped AI product
projects.description: Lead a team of three reporting to the CTO, taking an AI developer-tools product through discovery and six rapid product-vision iterations, and building it hands-on: a VS Code extension and Electron app on the Claude Agent SDK, plus an MCP server that lets AI agents query business data. Also co-led delivery and the mobile and web redesign of Bebop.

projects.name: A government-grade platform, delivered
projects.description: Led planning, design and delivery of three projects, including a government-grade platform where every region runs as a legally separate entity behind one reverse proxy. Migrated the legacy backend to NestJS, made the busiest requests faster with Redis and PostgreSQL tuning, added real-time chat and encrypted file storage, and shipped two Flutter apps.

projects.name: Turning around a stalled e-commerce business
projects.description: Resolved a year-long deadlock between a national clothing franchise and its development agency, took over the full infrastructure and led the migration to Magento 2, including mail-server recovery and the .dz domain setup.

projects.name: Co-founding and shipping a product
projects.description: Co-founded a pharmaceutical distribution platform and co-led its team of five developers. Built the role-based web app and two Flutter apps, made the product feel instant with caching and optimistic updates, caught crashes before users reported them, and self-hosted Odoo for internal operations.

projects.name: ResNet-18 accuracy at a hundredth of the size
projects.description: Designed a 97K-parameter network for small, class-imbalanced medical datasets. It matches or beats the ResNet-18 benchmark on all six MedMNIST tasks with about a hundredth of the parameters, and stays accurate where published lightweight networks lose up to eight AUC points.

projects.name: Accurate models from a few hundred images
projects.description: Built an 82K-parameter network whose first stage is constructed before training instead of learned, so it needs no pretrained weights and beats every from-scratch baseline on every seed across three medical tasks.

projects.name: Catching a flaw standard metrics hide
projects.description: Ran a five-factor ablation across four medical tasks showing that a common classifier-head design misgrades diabetic retinopathy further along the severity scale, a harm invisible to F1 and AUC, and that a single linear classifier matches heads 743× its size.

projects.name: Reviving a stalled patent project
projects.description: Completed a computer-vision project that had stalled for two years: a homography-free fiducial-marker algorithm in C++ fast enough for real time, wired through JNI into a Java Android app with OGRE 3D rendering.

projects.name: Dive Club
projects.description: Automated regional swimming competitions, making results more transparent and accurate.

projects.name: Agritech

projects.name: Zawya
projects.description: A desktop and mobile app for running Quranic schools: schedules, attendance and memorization tracking per student, and accounts for school heads and teachers across several schools.
